name: UserAgent
description:
Parsed User-Agent information. Only returned when `include=user_agent` or
`include=*` is used. The API parses the `User-Agent` header from the request.
For server-side usage, forward your visitor's User-Agent string in the header.

user_agent_string.description: The raw User-Agent string that was parsed.
user_agent_string.example: Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/143.0.0.0 Safari/537.36 Edg/143.0.0.0

type.description:
Client type classification. Common values: `Browser`, `Robot`,
`Mobile Browser`, `Library`.

version.description: Full version string of the detected client.

version_major.description: Major version number of the detected client.

device.description: Device information extracted from the User-Agent string.

brand.description: Device manufacturer or brand. `Unknown` if not detectable.

cpu.description: CPU architecture if detectable (e.g. `Intel x86_64`, `ARM`). `Unknown` otherwise.

engine.description: Rendering engine information extracted from the User-Agent string.

type.description: Engine classification. Typically matches the client type.

version.description: Full version of the rendering engine.

version_major.description: Major version of the rendering engine.

operating_system.description: Operating system information extracted from the User-Agent string.

version.description: OS version. `??` when the version cannot be determined.

version_major.description: OS major version. `??` when the version cannot be determined.

build.description: OS build number. `??` when the build cannot be determined.
